verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel says it provides end-to-end support from temporary nonimmigrant visas through to permanent residency. It also publishes a PDF of the most common routes to permanent residency and covers derivative green cards for family members, so a green-card continuation is broadly within scope. Nothing in the evidence names EB-1A or EB-2 NIW, or describes a documented strategy for moving from O-1 to a green card. Missing for 10: explicit EB-1A/EB-2 NIW documentation, an O-1-to-green-card transition strategy, founder-specific self-petition guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
